data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 暮夜窗畔的黑蕾丝试探
data.description: 都市高层公寓的落地窗外华灯流转，室内只亮着角落一盏暖暗壁灯。阳乃披着敞开的真丝晨袍斜倚在高背天鹅绒扶手椅扶手上，黑丝长腿优雅交叠，法式黑蕾丝套装与吊袜带在光影间若隐若现。她歪着头用指尖轻点唇边，带着一贯洞悉一切的戏谑浅笑反问「怎么，这就看呆了？」
data.location: 俯瞰都市夜色的高层公寓天鹅绒扶手椅旁
data.action: 斜倚高背扶手椅交叠黑丝长腿，指尖轻触唇角戏谑凝视
data.lighting: 室内暖暗壁灯与窗外柔和都市灯火交织出电影感明暗
data.camera: 四分之三中景，捕捉从容掌控感与成熟风韵
data.mood: 成熟、戏谑、游刃有余的成人魅力
data.promptProse: Perched gracefully against the arm of a dark velvet chair overlooking the glittering city skyline, Haruno Yukinoshita crosses her long legs in sheer black thigh-high stockings and touches one fingertip lightly to her lip. Her open silk dressing gown parts over the black floral lace balconette bra and garter belt as she offers a poised, teasing smile.
data.animaCaption: Leaning on a velvet armchair overlooking city lights, she crosses her legs and touches a finger to her lip with a teasing smile.
data.nsfwProse: The parted silk dressing gown reveals black French floral lace lingerie, garter straps, and sheer black thigh-high stockings in dim warm light.
